gloss: to pin someone down; to wrestle to the ground

definitions.gloss: to pin down; to wrestle to the ground; to overpower
definitions.explanation: To grapple with someone and force them face-down onto the ground, holding them in place. Often used for police subduing suspects or in martial arts contexts.

examples.japanese: {犯人|はんにん}を{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せた。
{警察官|けいさつかん}が{暴|あば}れる{男|おとこ}を{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せて{逮捕|たいほ}した。
examples.english: The police officer pinned down the violent man and arrested him.

examples.japanese: {通行人|つうこうにん}が{協力|きょうりょく}して{逃|に}げようとした{犯人|はんにん}を{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せ、{警察|けいさつ}が{到着|とうちゃく}するまで{押|お}さえていた。
examples.english: Passersby cooperated to pin down the fleeing suspect and held him until the police arrived.

notes:
{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる is a transitive ichidan verb. It is a compound of {組|く}む (to grapple, to wrestle) and {伏|ふ}せる (to lay face-down).

ASPECT (ている):
{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せている indicates the resulting state of having someone pinned down.

PARTICLE PATTERNS:
- [person]を{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to pin someone down)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {犯人|はんにん}を{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to pin down a criminal)
- {地面|じめん}に{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to wrestle to the ground)
- {取|と}り{押|お}さえて{組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる (to seize and pin down)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {組|く}み{伏|ふ}せる: to pin down physically by wrestling
- {取|と}り{押|お}さえる: to apprehend, to restrain (more general)
- {押|お}さえつける: to hold down, to press down
